title: Everything You Need to Know About Your LinkedIn URL
description:
With more than 800 million members on LinkedIn, a LinkedIn URL can make your profile easy to find and differentiate it. 

But how do you get one? And how can you make the most of it to help with your job search?

In this video we'll break down: 

00:00 Intro – What's a LinkedIn URL?
00:17 How to find your LinkedIn URL
00:39 Where should I put my LinkedIn URL?
01:17 Customizing and editing your LinkedIn URL (and why you should!)
02:40 Adding your LinkedIn URL to your resume
03:20 Don't use live links for URLs
03:59 Outro

What other questions do you have about your LinkedIn URL? Let us know in the comments.
